notebot.title: Notebot · Note Block Player
notebot.unsupported_song: Unplayable notes. See the detection report.
notebot.need_survival: Switch to Survival mode to play.
notebot.need_empty_hand: Use an empty main hand to avoid instantly mining note blocks with tools.
notebot.missing: %s note types missing. See report or tune blocks.
notebot.paused_ui: Paused: another screen is open or window lost focus.
notebot.arrangement_changed: Blocks changed or moved out of range. Paused.
notebot.tuned: Tuning complete. Press play to start.
notebot.no_sneak_tuning: Release the sneak key while tuning.
notebot.empty: No .nbs files. Open folder or drop files into this screen.
notebot.radius_tip: Drag the slider (0.5-block steps) or enter a number from 1 to 64; decimals allowed. Default 6. Applies and saves after typing stops. Invalid input turns red. Scanning, tuning and playback use this radius.
notebot.tuning_rate_tip: Drag or enter 1–80 packets/second. Default 20; saved automatically. Adjustable during tuning. Each batch still waits for server confirmation; latency limits actual speed.
notebot.radius_details: Scan radius %s blocks (server interaction reach still applies)
notebot.full_scale_tip: No song required. For each instrument with at least 25 usable blocks in range, prepare pitches 0–24 on 25 distinct blocks. Keep correct pitches, skip insufficient instruments and leave extra blocks unchanged. Uses the current tuning rate.
notebot.full_scale_none: No instrument has at least 25 usable blocks. See the detection report.
notebot.full_scale_tuning: Preparing full scales for %s instruments; %s blocks need tuning…
notebot.full_scale_done: %s instruments have complete pitches 0–24, ready for future songs.
notebot.tune_tip: Changes pitches by right clicking existing blocks. Preserves instruments. Only starts if enough blocks exist; press play afterwards.
notebot.fold_tip: Vanilla supports NBS keys 33–57. Folding shifts out-of-range notes by octaves and changes the original melody.
notebot.direct_packets_tip: Off by default; saved automatically. Playing and tuning ignore the empty-hand check, chat/container screens and window focus. The server still handles held items: tools may break note blocks, and tuning may use the held item.
notebot.hint: Rebind keys in Controls · Drop .nbs files to import
notebot.scan_excluded: Excluded: covered %s · out of reach %s · unsupported %s
notebot.folded: Folded %s notes into the vanilla range.
notebot.problem.range: Out of range: NBS key %s (vanilla supports 33–57)
notebot.problem.dense: More than 64 note types in game tick %s
notebot.compat_hint: Click each custom sound to choose one of 20 instruments. Applies to this load only. Page %s/%s
notebot.speed_hint: Original mode follows tempo events. Custom tempo scales the entire tempo map relative to the file header tempo. Enter 0.1–200 NBS ticks/sec, not BPM or tuning packets/sec. Musical position is preserved.
notebot.smart_failed: Analysis failed. Retry or choose manually.
notebot.smart_reason_low_register: Low register relative to the score; often the lowest voice
notebot.smart_reason_repeated_rhythm: Repeated notes and regular onset intervals
notebot.smart_reason_connected_line: Connected pitch movement suggests a melodic line
notebot.smart_reason_metadata_hint: Instrument or sound filename supports the suggestion
notebot.smart_reason_mixed_sections: Sections or role scores disagree; review manually
notebot.browser_empty: Open folders and search above to browse or find songs.
notebot.smart_preference_changed: Preference changed; run smart assignment again.
notebot.smart_preference_tip: Cycle six timbre preferences, then run smart assignment. Preferences preserve role detection and manual bindings. Shared instruments with mixed roles get lower confidence.
notebot.library_no_results: No songs in this folder or matching your search.
notebot.smart_preference_desc_balanced: Follow musical roles and existing instrument evidence.
notebot.smart_preference_desc_piano: Prefer piano and harp for melody and harmony.
notebot.smart_preference_desc_orchestral: Prefer flute, brass and orchestral bass.
notebot.smart_preference_desc_electronic: Prefer chip sounds and piano; preserve bass roles.
notebot.folder_open_tip: Launches the system file manager in the background without waiting for its exit. If no window appears, copy the path and paste it into the file manager.
notebot.highlight_tip: Green: matched; yellow: usable; red: covered; orange: outside radius; purple: unsupported. Client only, no packets. Current instrument/filter, up to %s boxes; resets on world change.
notebot.filter_tip: Click to cycle filters. Hover rows for full information; click a position to locate it.
notebot.scale_box_count: Need %s more usable boxes for a set of 25. Duplicate pitches can be retuned.
notebot.locate_tip: Click to return to the world and highlight only this box.
notebot.highlight_position: Located note block: %s, %s, %s. Disable highlighting in detection details.
notebot.scan_unloaded: %s unloaded chunks intersect the scan region; results may be incomplete.
notebot.position_hint: Click a position to locate it; highlights follow the selected filter.
